## Exercise

Describe the learner outcome, intended audience, and estimated duration.

## Files

List the exercise and its actual supporting assets.

## Sources and assumptions

Include authoritative URLs, relevant source revisions, consequential assumptions,
and unresolved conflicts or preview restrictions. Do not include private material.

## Verification

Separate static checks, local execution, and cloud end-to-end checks.
Explicitly identify checks that were not performed and tools that were unavailable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The exercise follows the approved template and uses a real target date.
- [ ] Required assets exist in `Labfiles` and relative links resolve.
- [ ] Starter placeholders match the instructions and implementation steps.
- [ ] Preview notes and targeted troubleshooting are included where relevant.
- [ ] Data is synthetic and no credentials or private information are included.
- [ ] Cleanup only affects resources created for this exercise.
- [ ] Sources, assumptions, and validation limitations are documented above.
